name: frozenholdout
description: Independently authored synthetic Russian context-cascade challenge. Required labels are based on explicit public attribution or explicit private use. Names and records are synthetic scenario content; this is not a representative sample or evidence of 95% production accuracy.
authorship_protocol: The author read only scripts/evaluate_semantic.py for the case and span schema and received the category names. Existing fixture examples, detector heuristics, model outputs, and benchmark results were not consulted. Sensitive substrings were manually selected before any inference; Unicode code-point offsets were calculated with exact string search only. Freeze this file before evaluation; do not tune labels or examples after viewing results.
pairing: The first 28 cases form 14 public/private context pairs; the next four form two hard-identifier pairs with and without quoted override attempts. The final four are unpaired ambiguity diagnostics.
diagnostic_policy: The four diagnostic cases lack enough context for unambiguous public/private truth. Their gold is an explicit conservative concealment preference, excluded from the required tier and not an accuracy claim.
